case.summary: A real-time model flagged a $1,000.03 online purchase on card C10434-K1 with a high score of 0.90. The evidence showed the amount was far above the card’s typical spend but the device was new, the email domain was anonymous, and the model’s fraud signal was weak, all pointing to a genuine customer. The team requested step-up authentication; the customer entered the one-time passcode on their registered phone and confirmed the purchase. Because the fraud probability was only 0.04 and the confirmation was received, the transaction was allowed and the case was closed as legitimate.
